title.zh: 卷一百十六 列傳第五十四: 徒單兀典 石盞女魯歡 蒲察官奴 內族:完顏承立一名慶山奴
title.en: Volume 116 Biographies 54: Tudan Wudian, Shizhannuluhuan, Pucha Guannu, Same Clan: Wanyanchengliyimingqingshannu
title.raw: 卷一百十六 列傳第五十四: 徒單兀典 石盞女魯歡 蒲察官奴 內族:完顏承立一名慶山奴 Volume 116 Biographies 54: Tudan Wudian, Shizhannuluhuan, Pucha Guannu, Same Clan: Wanyanchengliyimingqingshannu

sentences.zh: 徒單兀典

translations.literal: Tudan Wudian
translations.idiomatic: Tudan Wudian

sentences.zh: 徒單兀典，不知其所始，累官為武勝軍節度使，駐鄧州。

translations.literal: Tudan Wudian—his origins are unknown. Through successive appointments he became military commissioner of the Wusheng Army, stationed at Dengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Tudan Wudian's origins are not recorded. He rose through successive posts to military commissioner of the Wusheng Army and was stationed at Dengzhou.

sentences.zh: 尋遷中京留守，知金昌府事，駐洛陽。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter he was transferred to defender of the Central Capital, with charge of Jinchang Prefecture affairs, stationed at Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon transferred to defender of the Central Capital and superintendent of Jinchang Prefecture, with his headquarters at Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 鄧及洛陽兀典皆城之，且招亡命千人，號「熊虎軍」，以剽掠南鄙為事。

translations.literal: At both Deng and Luoyang Wudian fortified the cities, and moreover recruited a thousand fugitives, calling them the "Bear-Tiger Army," making raiding the southern marches their occupation.
translations.idiomatic: Wudian fortified both Dengzhou and Luoyang, recruited a thousand outlaws into a force he called the "Bear-Tiger Army," and set them to raiding the southern frontier.

sentences.zh: 宋人亦時時報復，邊民為之搔動。

translations.literal: The Song also struck back from time to time, and the border populace was thrown into turmoil on their account.
translations.idiomatic: The Song forces retaliated from time to time as well, and the border people lived in constant unrest.

sentences.zh: 兀典資性深刻，而以大自居，好設耳目，凡諸將官屬下及民家細事，令親昵日報之，務為不可欺。

translations.literal: Wudian was by nature deep and severe, yet placed himself above others; he liked to set up informants. For all generals, officials, subordinates, and the petty affairs of civilian households, he had intimates report daily, striving to leave nothing undetected.
translations.idiomatic: Wudian was deep and severe by nature yet carried himself as a grandee. He cultivated a network of informants so that generals, officials, subordinates, and even the petty affairs of common households were reported to him daily—he was determined that nothing escape his notice.

sentences.zh: 正大間，以兵部尚書權參知政事，行省事於徐州。

translations.literal: During the Zhengda period, as minister of war he served concurrently as acting councilor of state, exercising provincial authority at Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: During the Zhengda reign he was appointed minister of war and acting councilor of state, with provincial authority at Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 自恃得君，論議之際，不少假貸。

translations.literal: Relying on the emperor's favor, in deliberations he seldom showed forbearance.
translations.idiomatic: Secure in the emperor's favor, he showed little forbearance in council deliberations.

sentences.zh: 同列皆畏之。

translations.literal: His colleagues all feared him.
translations.idiomatic: His colleagues all feared him.

sentences.zh: 天興元年正月，朝廷聞大兵入饒風，移兀典行省閿鄉，以備潼關。

translations.literal: In the first month of the first year of Tianxing, the court heard that the great army had entered Raofeng; Wudian's provincial headquarters was moved to Minxiang to prepare the defense of Tong Pass.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Tianxing 1 (1232), the court learned that the Mongol army had entered Raofeng. Wudian's provincial headquarters was transferred to Minxiang to prepare the defense of Tong Pass.

sentences.zh: 徒單百家為關陝總帥，便宜行事。

translations.literal: Tudan Baijia was made overall commander of Guan and Shaan, with discretionary authority.
translations.idiomatic: Tudan Baijia was appointed overall commander of the Guan-Shaan region with discretionary authority.

sentences.zh: 百家馳入陝，榜州民雲：「淮南透漏軍馬，慮其道由潼關，勢不能守，縣鎮遷入大城，糧斛輜重聚之陝州，近山者入山寨避兵。」

translations.literal: Baijia galloped into Shaan and posted a notice to the prefectural populace, saying: "Enemy forces have leaked through from Huainan; fearing they may come by way of Tong Pass, the position cannot be held. County towns are to move into the great cities; grain and baggage are to be gathered at Shaanzhou; those near the mountains are to enter stockaded strongholds to avoid the troops."
translations.idiomatic: Baijia rode posthaste into Shaanzhou and posted a notice to the people: "Enemy forces have broken through from Huainan. Fearing they may advance by way of Tong Pass, we cannot hold this position. Move from the county towns into the major cities; concentrate grain and baggage at Shaanzhou; those near the mountains should take refuge in stockaded strongholds."

sentences.zh: 會阿裏合傳旨召兀典入援，兀典遂與潼關總帥納合合閏、秦藍總帥都點檢完顏重喜、安平都尉苗秀、蕩寇都尉術甲某、振武都尉張翼及虎威、鷹揚、葭州劉趙二帥，軍十有一萬、騎五千，盡撒秦藍諸隘之備。

translations.literal: It happened that Aliha transmitted an edict summoning Wudian to reinforce the capital. Wudian then joined with Tong Pass commander-in-chief Nahan Hehun, Qin-Lan overall commander and chief inspector Wanyan Chongxi, Anping commandant Miao Xiu, Bandit-Suppression commandant Shujia Mou, Zhenwu commandant Zhang Yi, and the Tiger Might, Eagle Soar, and the two commanders Liu and Zhao of Jia Prefecture—eleven thousand infantry and five thousand cavalry—and completely withdrew the defenses of all passes in Qin and Lan.
translations.idiomatic: Just then Aliha relayed an imperial order summoning Wudian to reinforce the capital. Wudian assembled Tong Pass commander-in-chief Nahan Hehun, Qin-Lan overall commander and chief inspector Wanyan Chongxi, commandants Miao Xiu of Anping, Shujia Mou of Bandit-Suppression, and Zhang Yi of Zhenwu, along with the Tiger Might, Eagle Soar, and the Liu and Zhao commanders of Jia Prefecture—eleven thousand foot soldiers and five thousand horsemen—and stripped all the pass defenses in Qin and Lan.

sentences.zh: 從虢入陝。

translations.literal: He entered Shaan from Guo.
translations.idiomatic: They entered Shaanzhou from Guo Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 同、華、閿鄉一帶軍糧數十萬斛，備關船二百餘艘，皆順流東下。

translations.literal: In the Tong, Hua, and Minxiang region military grain amounted to several hundred thousand hu; more than two hundred pass-defense boats were prepared—all went downstream to the east.
translations.idiomatic: Several hundred thousand hu of military grain in the Tong, Hua, and Minxiang region, along with more than two hundred supply boats, were all sent downstream to the east.

sentences.zh: 俄聞大兵近，糧皆不及載，船悉空下。

translations.literal: Shortly they heard the great army was near; the grain could not all be loaded in time, and the boats all went down empty.
translations.idiomatic: Soon word came that the Mongol army was near. There was no time to load the grain, and the boats sailed downstream empty.

sentences.zh: 複盡起州民，連靈寶、硤石倉粟，遊騎至，殺掠不勝計。

translations.literal: They again mobilized all the prefectural populace, linking the granaries of Lingbao and Xiaoshi; when roaming cavalry arrived, the killing and plundering were beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: They mobilized the entire prefectural population and emptied the granaries of Lingbao and Xiaoshi as well. When Mongol scouting parties arrived, the killing and plundering were beyond reckoning.

sentences.zh: 又遣陝州觀察副使兼規措轉運副使抹撚速也以船八十往運潼關、閿鄉糧，行及靈寶北河夾灘。

translations.literal: They also dispatched Shaanzhou assistant surveillance commissioner and concurrent assistant transport planning commissioner Mo'nian Suoye with eighty boats to transport grain from Tong Pass and Minxiang; they reached the narrows of the northern river at Lingbao.
translations.idiomatic: They also sent Shaanzhou assistant surveillance commissioner and concurrent assistant transport commissioner Mo'nian Suoye with eighty boats to transport grain from Tong Pass and Minxiang. The convoy reached the narrows of the northern river at Lingbao.

sentences.zh: 義軍張信、侯三集壯士三百余，保老幼，立水柵。

translations.literal: Volunteer forces Zhang Xin and Hou San gathered more than three hundred stalwarts, protected the old and young, and erected a water barrier.
translations.idiomatic: Volunteer commanders Zhang Xin and Hou San rallied more than three hundred stalwarts to protect the elderly and children and erected a water barrier.

sentences.zh: 北將忽魯罕只乘淺攻之不能克，遇速也船至即降，大兵得此船遂破侯、張，殺戮殆盡。

translations.literal: The northern general Huluhazi attacked at the shallows but could not overcome them. When Suoye's boats arrived he surrendered at once; the great army obtained these boats and then broke Hou and Zhang, slaughtering nearly all.
translations.idiomatic: The Mongol general Huluhazi attacked at the shallows but could not break through. When Suoye's boats arrived he surrendered immediately. The Mongols seized those boats, overran Hou and Zhang's force, and slaughtered nearly everyone.

sentences.zh: 是時陝州同知內族探春願從行省征進，兀典授以帥職，聽招在城民充軍。

translations.literal: At this time Shaanzhou vice prefect of the imperial clan Tanchun wished to follow the provincial headquarters on campaign; Wudian granted him a commander's post and permitted him to recruit city residents for the army.
translations.idiomatic: At this time Shaanzhou vice prefect Tanchun of the imperial clan volunteered to join the provincial headquarters on campaign. Wudian gave him a commander's commission and authorized him to recruit city residents into the army.

sentences.zh: 探春厚擬官賞。

translations.literal: Tanchun offered generous official rewards.
translations.idiomatic: Tanchun promised generous official rewards.

sentences.zh: 數日無一人，乃以兀典命招之，得壯士八百。

translations.literal: For several days not a single man came; then by Wudian's order they were recruited, obtaining eight hundred stalwarts.
translations.idiomatic: For several days not a single man enlisted. Only when recruitment was conducted under Wudian's direct order did they raise eight hundred stalwarts.

sentences.zh: 宣差趙三三名偉，亦依探春招募，偉人所知識，不二日得軍八百餘，號「破敵軍」。

translations.literal: Imperial commissioner Zhao San, named Wei, also recruited following Tanchun's model; from among those Wei knew, in less than two days he obtained more than eight hundred troops, calling them the "Enemy-Breaking Army."
translations.idiomatic: Imperial commissioner Zhao San, whose personal name was Wei, recruited in the same manner. Drawing on men he knew personally, he raised more than eight hundred troops in less than two days and called them the "Enemy-Breaking Army."

sentences.zh: 兀典忌偉得眾，欲挾詐坑之。

translations.literal: Wudian resented Wei for winning a following and wished to use a ruse to destroy him.
translations.idiomatic: Wudian resented Wei for winning such a following and plotted to destroy him by treachery.

sentences.zh: 完顏素蘭時為同華安撫使，力諫乃止。

translations.literal: Wanyan Sulan was then pacification commissioner of Tong and Hua; he remonstrated forcefully and only then was it stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Wanyan Sulan, then pacification commissioner of Tong and Hua, remonstrated forcefully, and Wudian abandoned the plan.

sentences.zh: 尋以偉權興寶軍節度使，兼行元帥府事，領軍三百，屯金雞堡。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter Wei was made acting military commissioner of the Xingbao Army, concurrently exercising metropolitan command authority, leading three hundred troops stationed at Golden Rooster Fort.
translations.idiomatic: Wei was soon appointed acting military commissioner of the Xingbao Army with concurrent metropolitan command authority, leading three hundred troops stationed at Golden Rooster Fort.

sentences.zh: 大兵即知潼關焚棄，長驅至陝。

translations.literal: The great army immediately learned that Tong Pass had been burned and abandoned, and drove straight to Shaan.
translations.idiomatic: The Mongols learned at once that Tong Pass had been burned and abandoned and marched straight to Shaanzhou.

sentences.zh: 賀都喜不待命出城迎戰，馬蹶幾為所獲，兀典易以一馬，遂下令不復令一人出，大兵亦去。

translations.literal: He Duxi, without awaiting orders, went out of the city to give battle; his horse stumbled and he was nearly captured. Wudian gave him another horse, then ordered that not one more man be sent out; the great army also withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: He Duxi went out to give battle without awaiting orders. His horse stumbled and he was nearly captured. Wudian gave him a replacement mount, then ordered that no one else leave the city. The Mongol army withdrew as well.

sentences.zh: 自此潼關諸渡船筏俱盡，偉亦無船可渡矣。

translations.literal: From this time all ferry boats and rafts at the Tong Pass crossings were gone, and Wei also had no boats by which to cross.
translations.idiomatic: From then on every boat and raft at the Tong Pass crossings was gone, and Wei had no means to cross the river either.

sentences.zh: 初，兀典發閿鄉，拜天，賞軍，人白金三兩，將校有差。

translations.literal: At the outset, when Wudian set out from Minxiang, he worshipped Heaven and rewarded the army—three taels of silver per man, with differences for officers.
translations.idiomatic: When Wudian first set out from Minxiang, he worshipped Heaven and rewarded the troops—three taels of silver per soldier, with graded amounts for officers.

sentences.zh: 州之庫藏，軍資器械，為之一空。

translations.literal: The prefecture's treasuries and military stores and equipment were emptied by this.
translations.idiomatic: The prefectural treasuries and all military stores and equipment were emptied.

sentences.zh: 期日進發，已而不行，日造銀器及兵幕牌印，陝州及鹽司牌亦奪取之。

translations.literal: A day was set for advance, yet afterward they did not move; day by day silver vessels and military tent plaques and seals were made, and the plaques of Shaanzhou and the Salt Commission were also seized.
translations.idiomatic: A departure date was set, yet they did not march. Day after day Wudian had silver vessels, military tent plaques, and seals manufactured, and he seized the official plaques of Shaanzhou and the Salt Commission as well.

sentences.zh: 又欲卻州民財物以資軍，素蘭諫之而止。

translations.literal: He also wished to take back the populace's goods and property to supply the army; Sulan remonstrated and it was stopped.
translations.idiomatic: He also planned to seize civilian property to fund the army, but Sulan's remonstrance put a stop to it.

sentences.zh: 二月戊午，乃行。

translations.literal: On the wuwu day of the second month, they finally marched.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day of the second month they finally set out.

sentences.zh: 有李先生者諫曰：「方今大兵俱在河南，河北空虛，相公可先取衛州，出其不意。

translations.literal: A certain Master Li remonstrated, saying: "At present the great army is all in Henan; Hebei is empty. Your Excellency could first take Weizhou by surprise.
translations.idiomatic: A certain Master Li remonstrated: "The Mongol army is now entirely in Henan, and Hebei lies empty. Your Excellency could seize Weizhou first and take them by surprise.

sentences.zh: 彼知我軍在北，必分兵北渡，京師即得少寬，相公入援亦易為矣。」

translations.literal: When they know our army is in the north, they will certainly divide forces to cross north; the capital will gain some relief, and Your Excellency's relief mission will also be easier."
translations.idiomatic: Once they learn our army is in the north, they will have to divide their forces to cross the river, giving the capital some breathing room and making your relief march far easier."

sentences.zh: 兀典大怒，以為泄軍機，斬之於市，遂行。

translations.literal: Wudian was greatly enraged, believing he had leaked military secrets, and executed him in the marketplace; then they marched.
translations.idiomatic: Wudian flew into a rage, accused him of leaking military secrets, and had him executed in the marketplace before marching on.

sentences.zh: 軍士各以老幼自隨。

translations.literal: Each soldier brought old and young dependents along.
translations.idiomatic: Every soldier brought his elderly dependents and children along.

sentences.zh: 州中亦有關中、河中遷避商賈老幼，亦倚兵力從行，婦女皆嫁士卒，軍中亦有強娶奪者。

translations.literal: In the prefecture there were also merchants and their old and young who had fled from Guanzhong and Hezhong; they too relied on military strength to go along. Women were all given in marriage to soldiers, and in the army there were also those who seized wives by force.
translations.idiomatic: Merchants and their families who had fled from Guanzhong and Hezhong also joined the column, trusting in military protection. Women were married off to soldiers, and some soldiers seized wives by force.

sentences.zh: 是日，軍出兩東門及南門，不遵洛陽路，乃由州西南徑入大山冰雪中。

translations.literal: That day the army went out through both eastern gates and the southern gate, not following the Luoyang road but entering directly into the great mountains and snow and ice by way of the prefecture's southwest.
translations.idiomatic: That day the army marched out through both eastern gates and the southern gate, avoiding the Luoyang road and plunging southwest from the prefecture straight into snowbound mountains.

sentences.zh: 葭州劉、趙兩帥即日叛去，大兵以數百騎遙躡其後。

translations.literal: The Liu and Zhao commanders of Jia Prefecture defected that very day; the great army followed at a distance with several hundred horsemen.
translations.idiomatic: The Liu and Zhao commanders of Jia Prefecture defected that same day. Several hundred Mongol horsemen trailed the column at a distance.

sentences.zh: 明日，張翼軍叛往硃陽，入鹿盧關，大兵追及降之。

translations.literal: The next day Zhang Yi's army defected toward Zhuyang, entered Lulu Pass, and when the great army caught up they surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: The next day Zhang Yi's force defected toward Zhuyang and entered Lulu Pass. The Mongols caught up and accepted their surrender.

sentences.zh: 山路積雪，晝日凍釋，泥淖及脛，隨軍婦女棄擲幼稚，哀號盈路。

translations.literal: Snow lay deep on the mountain road; by day it thawed and froze again, mud reaching to the shins. Women following the army abandoned infants; wailing filled the road.
translations.idiomatic: Snow lay deep on the mountain paths. By day it thawed and refroze, mud reaching to the shins. Women in the column abandoned their infants, and wailing filled the road.

sentences.zh: 軍至鐵嶺，大兵潛召洛陽大軍從西三縣過盧氏，所至燒官民廬舍積聚，慮為金軍所據，又反守鐵嶺，以斷歸路。

translations.literal: When the army reached Tieling, the great army secretly summoned the Luoyang forces to pass through the three western counties via Lushi; wherever they went they burned official and civilian dwellings and stores, fearing the Jin army would seize them; they also turned back to hold Tieling and cut off the route of retreat.
translations.idiomatic: When the Jin army reached Tieling, the Mongols secretly summoned their Luoyang forces through the three western counties via Lushi. Wherever they went they burned official and civilian buildings and stores lest the Jin seize them, then turned back to hold Tieling and cut off the retreat.

sentences.zh: 金兵知必死，皆有鬥志，然已數日不食，行二百里許，困憊不支，頗亦散走。

translations.literal: The Jin troops knew they must die and all had fighting spirit, yet they had not eaten for several days; after marching some two hundred li they were exhausted beyond endurance and many also scattered and fled.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin soldiers knew they faced certain death and fought with desperate resolve, but they had not eaten for days. After marching some two hundred li they collapsed from exhaustion, and many scattered in flight.

sentences.zh: 於是完顏重喜先降，大軍斬于馬前。

translations.literal: Thereupon Wanyan Chongxi surrendered first, and the great army beheaded him before their horses.
translations.idiomatic: Wanyan Chongxi was the first to surrender, and the Mongols beheaded him before their horses.

sentences.zh: 鄭倜劫苗英降，英不從，殺之，攜其首以降，於是士卒大潰。

translations.literal: Zheng Tong seized Miao Ying to force his surrender; Ying refused and was killed. Tong carried his head to surrender, and then the soldiers collapsed in great rout.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Tong tried to force Miao Ying to surrender. Ying refused and was killed. Tong carried Ying's head to the Mongols and surrendered, and the army collapsed in rout.

sentences.zh: 兀典、合閏提數十騎走山間，追騎禽得，皆殺之。

translations.literal: Wudian and Hehun took several dozen horsemen and fled through the mountains; pursuing riders captured them and all were killed.
translations.idiomatic: Wudian and Hehun fled through the mountains with several dozen horsemen. Pursuers overtook and captured them, and both were executed.

sentences.zh: 先是，兀典嘗為鄧州節度使，世襲謀克黃摑三合時為宣差都總領，與兀典親厚，故決計入鄧。

translations.literal: Earlier, Wudian had once been military commissioner of Dengzhou; the hereditary commander Huangzha Sanheshi was imperial commissioner and overall chief, on intimate terms with Wudian, and therefore the decision was made to enter Deng.
translations.idiomatic: Wudian had previously served as military commissioner of Dengzhou. The hereditary commander Huangzha Sanheshi, then imperial commissioner and overall chief, was on close terms with him, which is why the army resolved to march toward Deng.

sentences.zh: 是役也，安平、蕩寇、鷹揚、振威諸都尉，及西安、金雞等軍，脫走者百才一二。

translations.literal: In this campaign, of the Anping, Bandit-Suppression, Eagle Soar, and Zhenwei commandants, and the Xi'an, Golden Rooster, and other forces, only one or two in a hundred escaped.
translations.idiomatic: Of the Anping, Bandit-Suppression, Eagle Soar, and Zhenwei commandants and the Xi'an, Golden Rooster, and other units, scarcely one or two in a hundred escaped.

sentences.zh: 二月，素蘭竄歸，有報徒單百家言「行省至」，百家欲出迎，父老遮馬前哀訴雲：「行省複來，吾州碎矣，願無出迎。」

translations.literal: In the second month Sulan fled back. Someone reported to Tudan Baijia that "the provincial headquarters has arrived." Baijia wished to go out to welcome them; elders blocked his horse and pleaded in grief: "If the provincial headquarters comes again, our prefecture will be shattered—please do not go out to welcome them."
translations.idiomatic: In the second month Sulan fled back to Shaanzhou. Someone reported to Tudan Baijia that the provincial headquarters was approaching. Baijia prepared to go out and welcome them, but elders blocked his horse and pleaded: "If the provincial headquarters returns, our prefecture will be ruined—please do not go out to meet them."

sentences.zh: 百家曉之曰：「前日兀典，欲劫此州，為素蘭力勸而止，此行省非兀典，乃素蘭也。」

translations.literal: Baijia explained to them: "The other day it was Wudian who wished to plunder this prefecture; it was stopped by Sulan's forceful persuasion. This provincial headquarters is not Wudian—it is Sulan."
translations.idiomatic: Baijia explained: "It was Wudian who wanted to plunder this prefecture the other day, and only Sulan's forceful persuasion stopped him. The man approaching is not Wudian—it is Sulan."

sentences.zh: 父老乃聽百家出城。

translations.literal: The elders then permitted Baijia to leave the city.
translations.idiomatic: The elders relented and allowed Baijia to leave the city.

sentences.zh: 陝州自軍出。

translations.literal: Since the army had left Shaanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: From the time the army had marched out of Shaanzhou,

sentences.zh: 日有逃還者，百家皆撫納之，所得及萬人。

translations.literal: each day there were fugitives returning; Baijia received and comforted them all, obtaining nearly ten thousand men.
translations.idiomatic: fugitives returned day by day. Baijia received and comforted them all, eventually gathering nearly ten thousand men.

sentences.zh: 百家又募收所棄甲仗。

translations.literal: Baijia also recruited men to collect abandoned armor and weapons.
translations.idiomatic: Baijia also recruited men to collect abandoned arms and armor.

sentences.zh: 若獲二副，即以一與之，其一官出直買之，由是軍稍振。

translations.literal: If two sets were recovered, one was given to the finder and the other the government bought at full price; by this the army was somewhat restored.
translations.idiomatic: For every two sets recovered, one was given to the finder and the government bought the other at full price. By this means the army was somewhat restored.

sentences.zh: 五月，總帥副點檢顏盞領軍複立商州總帥。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, overall commander's deputy chief inspector Yanzhan led troops and re-established the Shangzhou overall commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, the overall commander's deputy chief inspector Yanzhan led troops and re-established the Shangzhou overall command.

sentences.zh: 華州人王某立虢州，權刺史。

translations.literal: A certain Wang of Huazhou established Guo Prefecture and served as acting prefect.
translations.idiomatic: A certain Wang of Huazhou established a hold at Guo Prefecture and served as acting prefect.

sentences.zh: 七月，制旨召百家入援，以權西安軍節度使、行元帥事阿不罕奴十剌為金安軍節度使、關陝總帥。

translations.literal: In the seventh month an imperial order summoned Baijia to reinforce the capital; Abuhan Nushila, acting military commissioner of the Xi'an Army exercising metropolitan command, was made military commissioner of the Jin'an Army and overall commander of Guan and Shaan.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month an imperial order summoned Baijia to reinforce the capital. Abuhan Nushila, acting military commissioner of the Xi'an Army with metropolitan command authority, was appointed military commissioner of the Jin'an Army and overall commander of Guan-Shaan.

sentences.zh: 九月，鞏昌知府元帥完顏忽斜虎入陝州，詔拜參知政事，行尚書省事。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Gongchang prefect and commander Wanyan Huxiehu entered Shaanzhou; an edict appointed him councilor of state, exercising the duties of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Gongchang prefect and commander Wanyan Huxiehu entered Shaanzhou and was appointed councilor of state with authority over the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 以河中總帥府經歷李獻能充左右司員外郎。

translations.literal: Li Xianneng, secretary of the Hezhong metropolitan command, was made left and right department assistant commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Li Xianneng, secretary of the Hezhong metropolitan headquarters, was appointed assistant commissioner of the left and right departments.

sentences.zh: 獻能字欽叔，貞祐三年進士。

translations.literal: Xianneng's style name was Qinshu; he was a jinshi of the third year of Zhenyou.
translations.idiomatic: Xianneng, style name Qinshu, had passed the jinshi examination in Zhenyou 3 (1215).

sentences.zh: 複立山寨，安撫軍民。

translations.literal: He re-established stockaded strongholds and pacified soldiers and civilians.
translations.idiomatic: He re-established mountain stockades and pacified soldiers and civilians.

sentences.zh: 十月朔，制旨召忽斜虎赴南陽留山寺，以阿不罕奴十剌權參知政事，行省。

translations.literal: On the first day of the tenth month an imperial order summoned Huxiehu to Liushan Temple in Nanyang; Abuhan Nushila was made acting councilor of state with provincial authority.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the tenth month an imperial order summoned Huxiehu to Liushan Temple in Nanyang. Abuhan Nushila was appointed acting councilor of state with provincial authority.

sentences.zh: 時趙偉為河解元帥，屯金雞堡，軍務隸陝省，行省月給糧以贍其軍。

translations.literal: At this time Zhao Wei was He-Jie commander, stationed at Golden Rooster Fort; military affairs were subordinate to Shaan province, and the provincial headquarters supplied grain monthly to sustain his army.
translations.idiomatic: At this time Zhao Wei served as He-Jie commander, stationed at Golden Rooster Fort. His forces were subordinate to the Shaan provincial headquarters, which supplied them with monthly grain rations.

sentences.zh: 明年五月，麥熟，省劄令偉計置兵食，權罷月給。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the following year, when wheat ripened, a provincial memorandum ordered Wei to arrange military provisions and temporarily suspended the monthly allotment.
translations.idiomatic: The following fifth month, when the wheat ripened, the provincial headquarters ordered Wei to arrange his own provisions and temporarily suspended the monthly rations.

sentences.zh: 十月，偉軍食又盡，屢白陝省，雲無糧可給，偉私謂其軍言：「我與李員外郎有隙，坐視我軍饑餓，不為存恤。」

translations.literal: In the tenth month Wei's army provisions were again exhausted; he repeatedly reported to Shaan province, which said there was no grain to supply. Wei privately told his troops: "I have a feud with Assistant Commissioner Li; he sits by while our army starves and shows no care."
translations.idiomatic: By the tenth month Wei's provisions were exhausted again. He repeatedly petitioned the Shaan provincial headquarters, which replied that no grain was available. Wei told his troops privately: "I have a feud with Assistant Commissioner Li. He sits by while our army starves and refuses to help us."

sentences.zh: 於是自往永甯勸喻，偉頗為小民所信，往往獻糧，或導其發藏。

translations.literal: Thereupon he went himself to Yongning to persuade the people; Wei was rather trusted by common folk, who often presented grain or guided him to hidden stores.
translations.idiomatic: He then went to Yongning himself to persuade the people. The common folk trusted Wei, and many brought grain or guided him to hidden stores.

sentences.zh: 南縣把隘軍提控以偉橫恣言於行省，行省遣趙提控者權元帥，守永寧元村寨，偉還金雞。

translations.literal: The Naxian pass-defense army commander reported to the provincial headquarters that Wei was overbearing and insubordinate; the provincial headquarters sent Commander Zhao as acting commander to hold Yongning's Yuanjia stockade, and Wei returned to Golden Rooster.
translations.idiomatic: The Naxian pass-defense commander reported to the provincial headquarters that Wei was overbearing and insubordinate. The headquarters sent Commander Zhao as acting commander to hold Yongning's Yuanjia stockade, and Wei returned to Golden Rooster Fort.

sentences.zh: 十一月冬至，大兵已攻破元村寨，偉攻解州不能下，於是密遣總領王茂軍士三十人入陝州。

translations.literal: On the winter solstice of the eleventh month the great army had already taken Yuanjia stockade; Wei attacked Jie Prefecture but could not capture it. Thereupon he secretly sent overall chief Wang Mao with thirty soldiers into Shaanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the winter solstice of the eleventh month the Mongols had already taken Yuanjia stockade. Wei attacked Jie Prefecture without success. He then secretly sent overall chief Wang Mao with thirty soldiers into Shaanzhou.

sentences.zh: 匿菜圃中凡三四日，乘夜，王茂殺北城邏卒，舉號召偉軍八百渡河，入城劫殺阿不罕奴十剌、李獻能、提控蒲鮮某、總領來道安，因誣奏：「奴十剌等欲反，臣誅之矣。」

translations.literal: They hid in a vegetable garden for three or four days; in the night Wang Mao killed the northern wall patrol soldiers, raised a signal, and summoned Wei's eight hundred troops to cross the river, enter the city, and seize and kill Abuhan Nushila, Li Xianneng, commander Puxian Mou, and overall chief Lai Dao'an. He then falsely memorialized: "Nushila and the others wished to rebel; your servant has executed them."
translations.idiomatic: They hid in a vegetable garden for three or four days. In the night Wang Mao killed the northern-wall patrol, raised a signal, and summoned Wei's eight hundred troops across the river. They entered the city and killed Abuhan Nushila, Li Xianneng, commander Puxian Mou, and overall chief Lai Dao'an. Wei then filed a false memorial: "Nushila and the others were plotting rebellion. I have executed them."

sentences.zh: 朝廷知其冤而莫敢詰，就授偉元帥左監軍，兼西安軍節度使，行總帥府事。

translations.literal: The court knew they were wronged yet dared not investigate; Wei was thereupon appointed left army supervising general, concurrently military commissioner of the Xi'an Army, exercising metropolitan command.
translations.idiomatic: The court knew they had been wronged but dared not investigate. Wei was promptly appointed left army supervising general, military commissioner of the Xi'an Army, with metropolitan command authority.

sentences.zh: 食盡。

translations.literal: Provisions were exhausted.
translations.idiomatic: Provisions ran out.

sentences.zh: 括粟，粟又盡，以明年三月降大兵。

translations.literal: Grain was requisitioned; when grain was again exhausted, in the third month of the following year he surrendered to the great army.
translations.idiomatic: Grain was requisitioned until none remained. In the third month of the following year he surrendered to the Mongols.

sentences.zh: 或謂偉軍餉不繼，以劫掠自資，一日詣李獻能，獻能靳之，曰：「從宜破敵不易。」

translations.literal: Some say that because Wei's army provisions were not sustained, he supported himself by raiding; one day he called on Li Xianneng, and Xianneng was stingy, saying: "It is not easy to break the enemy as circumstances require."
translations.idiomatic: Some say that because Wei's army rations were not sustained, he supported his troops by raiding. One day he called on Li Xianneng, who was stingy with him and said, "Breaking the enemy as circumstances require is no easy matter."

sentences.zh: 由是憾之。

translations.literal: From this he bore resentment.
translations.idiomatic: From this Wei bore him a grudge.

sentences.zh: 乃乘奴十剌宴飲不設備，選死士二十八人，夜由後河灘逾城而上，取餅爐碎石擲屋瓦門扇為箭鏃聲。

translations.literal: He then took advantage of Nushila feasting without precautions, selected twenty-eight death-dedicated warriors, and at night crossed the rear river beach and scaled the wall, taking stove stones and tiles from roofs and door panels to throw as if arrowheads were flying.
translations.idiomatic: He then took advantage of Nushila feasting without precautions, selected twenty-eight picked warriors, and at night scaled the wall from the rear river beach. They hurled stove stones and roof tiles to mimic the sound of arrow volleys.

sentences.zh: 州人疑叛軍多，不敢動，遂開門納軍。

translations.literal: The prefectural people suspected many rebels and dared not move; they then opened the gates and admitted the troops.
translations.idiomatic: The townspeople, thinking many rebels had entered, dared not stir. The gates were opened and the troops admitted.

sentences.zh: 殺行省以下官屬二十一人，獻能最為所恨，故被害尤酷。

translations.literal: They killed twenty-one officials below the provincial headquarters; Xianneng was most hated by him, and therefore suffered especially cruel death.
translations.idiomatic: They killed twenty-one officials of the provincial staff. Xianneng, whom Wei hated most, suffered an especially cruel death.

sentences.zh: 偉之變，絳州錄事張升字進之，大同人，戶工部令史出身，曾為漁陽簿，遷絳州錄事，謂知識者曰：「我本小人，受國家官祿，今日國家遭不幸，我不能從反賊。」

translations.literal: At Wei's mutiny, Jiangzhou registrar Zhang Sheng, style name Jinzhi, a native of Datong, rose from a clerkship in the Ministry of Revenue and Works, had once been Yuyang magistrate, and was transferred to Jiangzhou registrar. He told those he knew: "I am originally a petty man who received official salary from the state. Today the state suffers misfortune; I cannot follow a rebel."
translations.idiomatic: When Wei mutinied, Jiangzhou registrar Zhang Sheng, style name Jinzhi, a native of Datong who had risen from a clerkship in the Ministry of Revenue and Works and once served as magistrate of Yuyang, told his acquaintances: "I am only a humble man who has received salary from the state. Now that the state faces calamity, I cannot follow a rebel."

sentences.zh: 言訖，赴水死，岸上數百人皆嗟惜之。

translations.literal: When he had finished speaking, he went into the water and died; several hundred on the bank all sighed in regret.
translations.idiomatic: With these words he drowned himself in the river. Several hundred people on the bank sighed in sorrow.

sentences.zh: 及徒單百家鄭西之敗，單騎間道數百里入京。

translations.literal: When Tudan Baijia was defeated west of Zheng, he entered the capital alone on horseback by hidden paths for several hundred li.
translations.idiomatic: After Tudan Baijia's defeat west of Zheng, he rode alone by hidden paths for several hundred li to reach the capital.

sentences.zh: 為上言兀典等鐵嶺敗狀。

translations.literal: He reported to the emperor the circumstances of Wudian and the others' defeat at Tieling.
translations.idiomatic: He reported to the emperor the circumstances of Wudian's defeat at Tieling.

sentences.zh: 於是籍重喜、合閏、兀典家貲，暴兀典為罪首，榜通衢雲。

translations.literal: Thereupon the properties of Chongxi, Hehun, and Wudian were registered; Wudian was exposed as chief culprit, and placards were posted in the public thoroughfares.
translations.idiomatic: The properties of Chongxi, Hehun, and Wudian were then confiscated. Wudian was denounced as the chief culprit, and placards were posted throughout the capital.

sentences.zh: 石盞女魯歡

translations.literal: Shizhan Nülühuan
translations.idiomatic: Shizhan Nülühuan

sentences.zh: 石盞女魯歡，本名十六。

translations.literal: Shizhan Nülühuan, original name Shiliu.
translations.idiomatic: Shizhan Nülühuan, whose original name was Shiliu.

sentences.zh: 興定三年，以河南路統軍使為元帥右都監，行平涼元帥府事。

translations.literal: In the third year of Xingding, as Henan circuit overall military commissioner he was made right deputy commander of the metropolitan command, exercising Pingliang metropolitan headquarters affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In Xingding 3 (1219) he was transferred from Henan circuit overall military commissioner to right deputy commander of the metropolitan command, with authority over the Pingliang metropolitan headquarters.

sentences.zh: 先是，陝西行省胥鼎言：「平涼控制西垂，實為要地。

translations.literal: Earlier, Shaan provincial commissioner Xu Ding said: "Pingliang controls the western frontier and is truly a vital position.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Shaan provincial commissioner Xu Ding had said: "Pingliang controls the western frontier and is a position of vital importance.

sentences.zh: 都監女奚烈古里間材識凡庸，不閑軍務，且以入粟補官，遂得升用，握重兵，當方面，豈能服眾。

translations.literal: Deputy commander Nüxilie Gulijian's talent and insight are mediocre, he is unskilled in military affairs, and moreover gained promotion by purchasing grain for official rank—yet he holds heavy troops and faces a whole region; how can he win the troops' obedience?
translations.idiomatic: Deputy commander Nüxilie Gulijian is mediocre in talent and untrained in military affairs. He gained promotion by purchasing grain for official rank, yet now commands heavy forces on a whole frontier—how can he win the troops' obedience?

sentences.zh: 防秋在邇，宜選才謀、有宿望、善將兵者代之。」

translations.literal: Autumn defense is near; one should select someone of talent and strategy, with longstanding reputation, skilled at commanding troops, to replace him."
translations.idiomatic: Autumn defense is approaching. You should select someone of talent and strategy, with a longstanding reputation and skill at commanding troops, to replace him."

sentences.zh: 故以命女魯歡。

translations.literal: Therefore Nülühuan was appointed.
translations.idiomatic: Nülühuan was therefore appointed to the post.

sentences.zh: 十一月，女魯歡上言：「鎮戎赤溝川，東西四十裏，地無險阻，當夏人往來之沖，比屢侵突，金兵常不得利。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month Nülühuan memorialized: "At Zhenrong's Red Ditch River, forty li east to west, the terrain has no natural barriers; it lies on the route of Xia comings and goings. Recently they have repeatedly raided, and Jin troops have often gained no advantage.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Nülühuan memorialized: "At Zhenrong's Red Ditch River, forty li from east to west, the terrain offers no natural barriers. It lies on the route of Tangut movements. They have raided repeatedly of late, and our troops have rarely gained the advantage.

sentences.zh: 明年春，當城鎮戎，彼必出兵來撓。

translations.literal: Next spring we should fortify Zhenrong; they will certainly send troops to interfere.
translations.idiomatic: Next spring we should fortify Zhenrong. The Tanguts will certainly send troops to interfere.

sentences.zh: 乞於二三月間征傍郡兵，聲言防護，且令鄜、鞏各屯兵境上示進伐之勢，以制其肘。

translations.literal: I beg that in the second and third months troops from neighboring prefectures be mobilized, proclaiming defense, and moreover that Fu and Gong each station troops on the border showing an advance posture, to pin their arms.
translations.idiomatic: I request that in the second and third months we mobilize troops from neighboring prefectures under the pretext of defense, and station forces from Fu and Gong on the border in a show of advance, to pin the enemy's arms.

sentences.zh: 臣領平涼之眾，由鎮戎而入，攻其心腹。

translations.literal: Your servant will lead Pingliang's forces, entering by way of Zhenrong, to strike their heartland.
translations.idiomatic: I will lead Pingliang's forces through Zhenrong to strike at their heartland.

sentences.zh: 彼自救之不暇，安能及我。

translations.literal: They will have no leisure to save themselves—how could they reach us?
translations.idiomatic: They will be too busy saving themselves to trouble us.

sentences.zh: 如此則鎮戎可城，而彼亦不敢來犯。

translations.literal: In this way Zhenrong can be fortified, and they also will not dare come to invade.
translations.idiomatic: In this way Zhenrong can be fortified, and they will not dare invade.

sentences.zh: 又所在官軍多河北、山西失業之人，其家屬仰給縣官，每患不足。

translations.literal: Moreover, the government troops everywhere are mostly unemployed men from Hebei and Shanxi; their families depend on county officials for support, and are often short.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, the government troops in these regions are mostly unemployed men from Hebei and Shanxi whose families depend on county stipends that are often insufficient.

sentences.zh: 鎮戎土壤肥沃，又且平衍，臣裨將所統幾八千人，每以遷徙不常為病。

translations.literal: Zhenrong's soil is fertile and moreover level and open; the subordinate generals under your servant command nearly eight thousand men, and the constant relocations have always been a hardship.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenrong's soil is fertile and level, and the subordinate generals under my command number nearly eight thousand men. The constant relocations have always been a hardship.

sentences.zh: 若授以荒田，使耕且戰，則可以禦備一方，縣官省費而食亦足矣。

translations.literal: If wasteland is granted them to farm while fighting, they could defend one sector; the government would save expense and provisions would suffice.
translations.idiomatic: If they are granted wasteland to farm while fighting, they could defend the frontier, the government would save expense, and provisions would suffice.

sentences.zh: 其餘邊郡亦宜一體措置。」

translations.literal: The other border prefectures should also be arranged in the same manner."
translations.idiomatic: The other border prefectures should be arranged in the same way."

sentences.zh: 上嘉納焉。

translations.literal: The emperor praised and accepted it.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised and accepted the proposal.

sentences.zh: 遷昌武軍節度使。

translations.literal: He was transferred to military commissioner of the Changwu Army.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to military commissioner of the Changwu Army.

sentences.zh: 元光二年九月，又言：「商洛重地，西控秦陝，東接河南，軍務繁密，宜選才幹之士為防禦使、攝帥職以鎮之。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the second year of Yuanguang, he again memorialized: "Shangluo is a vital position, controlling Qin and Shaan to the west and connecting with Henan to the east; military affairs are dense. One should select a man of talent and capacity as defense commissioner and acting commander to secure it.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the second year of Yuanguang, he memorialized again: "Shangluo is a vital position controlling Qin-Shaan to the west and connecting with Henan to the east. Military affairs there are pressing. A man of talent and capacity should be chosen as defense commissioner with acting command authority to secure it.

sentences.zh: 又舊來諸隘守禦之官，並從帥府辟置，其所辟者，多其親昵，殖產營私，專事漁獵，及當代去，又複保留，此最害之甚者。

translations.literal: Moreover, the officials who guard the various passes have all been appointed by the metropolitan headquarters; those appointed are mostly their intimates, who amass property for private gain and devote themselves to extortion. When their term ends they are retained again—this is the most harmful abuse of all.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, the pass-defense officials have all been appointed by the metropolitan headquarters, and those appointed are mostly commanders' intimates who amass property, extort the people, and devote themselves to private gain. When their terms end they are retained again. This is the worst abuse of all.

sentences.zh: 宜令樞府選舉，以革其弊。

translations.literal: The Bureau of Military Affairs should be ordered to select candidates, to reform this abuse.
translations.idiomatic: The Bureau of Military Affairs should select candidates to reform this abuse.

sentences.zh: 又州之戍兵艱於饋運，亦合依上屯田，以免轉輸之費。」

translations.literal: Moreover, the garrison troops of the prefecture find supply transport difficult; they too should follow the garrison-farming plan above to avoid transport costs."
translations.idiomatic: The prefectural garrison troops also find supply transport difficult. They too should follow the garrison-farming plan described above to avoid transport costs."

sentences.zh: 又言：「每年防秋，諸隘守者不過數十人，餘眾盡屯保安、石門、大荊、洛南以為應援，中間相距遠至百里，倉猝豈能徵集。

translations.literal: He also said: "Each year for autumn defense, the pass garrisons have no more than several dozen men; the rest are all stationed at Bao'an, Shimen, Dajing, and Luonan as reinforcements. The distance between them reaches a hundred li; how could they be gathered in haste?
translations.idiomatic: He also said: "Each autumn defense season, the pass garrisons hold no more than several dozen men while the rest are stationed at Bao'an, Shimen, Dajing, and Luonan as reinforcements. The distance between them can reach a hundred li. How could they be gathered in an emergency?

sentences.zh: 宜近隘築營。

translations.literal: Camps should be built near the passes.
translations.idiomatic: Camps should be built near the passes.

sentences.zh: 徙見兵居之，以待緩急。

translations.literal: The available troops should be moved to dwell there, to await emergencies.
translations.idiomatic: Available troops should be stationed there to await emergencies.

sentences.zh: 又南邊所設巡檢十員，兵率千人，此乃平時以詰奸細者，已有大軍。

translations.literal: Moreover, the ten inspection commissioners set up on the southern border, each with troops averaging a thousand men—these are for interrogating spies in peacetime, yet there is already a great army.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, the ten border inspection commissioners on the southern frontier, each commanding roughly a thousand men, were meant for routine spy-catching duties. A major army is already in place.

sentences.zh: 宜悉罷去。」

translations.literal: They should all be abolished."
translations.idiomatic: They should all be abolished."

sentences.zh: 朝廷略施行之。

translations.literal: The court implemented it in part.
translations.idiomatic: The court implemented his proposals in part.

sentences.zh: 正大九年二月，以行樞密院事守歸德。

translations.literal: In the second month of the ninth year of Zhengda, exercising duties of the Bureau of Military Affairs, he defended Guide.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of Zhengda 9, with authority over the Bureau of Military Affairs, he defended Guide.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，大元將忒木泬率真定、信安、大名、東平、益都諸軍來攻。

translations.literal: On the yichou day, the Great Yuan general Temü led the armies of Zhending, Xin'an, Daming, Dongping, and Yidu to attack.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day, the Mongol general Temü led armies from Zhending, Xin'an, Daming, Dongping, and Yidu to attack.

sentences.zh: 是日，無雲而雷，有以《神武秘略》占之者，曰「其城無害」，人心稍安。

translations.literal: That day there was thunder without clouds; someone divined by the Secret Essentials of Divine Warfare and said "the city will suffer no harm," and hearts were somewhat reassured.
translations.idiomatic: That day thunder sounded without clouds. Someone divined using the Secret Essentials of Divine Warfare and declared that the city would suffer no harm, and the people's spirits were somewhat reassured.

sentences.zh: 適慶山奴潰軍亦至，城中得之，頗有鬥志。

translations.literal: Just then the routed troops of Qingshannu also arrived; the city received them and fighting spirit was considerable.
translations.idiomatic: Just then the routed troops of Qingshannu also arrived. The city welcomed them, and morale improved considerably.

sentences.zh: 己巳，提控張定夜出斫營，發數砲而還。

translations.literal: On the jisi day, commander Zhang Ding went out at night to strike the enemy camp, fired several cannon shots, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day, commander Zhang Ding led a night raid on the enemy camp, fired several cannon shots, and returned.

sentences.zh: 定平日好談兵，女魯歡令自募一軍，使為提控，小試而勝，上下遂恃以為可用。

translations.literal: Ding was ordinarily fond of discussing military affairs; Nülühuan ordered him to recruit an army himself and made him commander. A small trial ended in victory, and superiors and subordinates then relied on him as usable.
translations.idiomatic: Ding was ordinarily fond of military talk. Nülühuan ordered him to recruit his own force and appointed him commander. A small trial action ended in victory, and the court came to rely on him.

sentences.zh: 初患砲少，欲以泥或磚為之，議者恐為敵所輕，不復用。

translations.literal: At first they worried cannon were few and wished to make them of clay or brick; discussants feared the enemy would despise them, and the plan was not adopted.
translations.idiomatic: At first they worried about the shortage of cannon and considered making them of clay or brick, but advisers feared the enemy would despise such weapons and the plan was dropped.

sentences.zh: 父老有言北門之西一菜圃中時得古砲，雲是唐張巡所埋，掘之，得五千有奇，上有刻字或「大吉」字者。

translations.literal: Elders said that in a vegetable garden west of the north gate ancient cannon were sometimes found, said to have been buried by Tang's Zhang Xun; they were dug up and more than five thousand were obtained, some inscribed or bearing the character "Great Fortune."
translations.idiomatic: Elders said that ancient cannon were sometimes found in a vegetable garden west of the north gate, said to have been buried by the Tang general Zhang Xun. They were dug up and more than five thousand were recovered, some inscribed or bearing the character for "great fortune."

sentences.zh: 大兵晝夜攻城，駐營於南城外，其地勢稍高。

translations.literal: The great army attacked day and night, encamping south of the outer city where the ground was somewhat higher.
translations.idiomatic: The Mongol army attacked day and night, encamping south of the outer city on slightly higher ground.

sentences.zh: 相傳是安祿山將尹子奇於此攻巡、遠，得睢陽。

translations.literal: Tradition holds that here An Lushan's general Yin Ziqi attacked Xun and Yuan and took Suiyang.
translations.idiomatic: Tradition holds that here An Lushan's general Yin Ziqi attacked Zhang Xun and Xu Yuan and captured Suiyang.

sentences.zh: 時經歷冀禹錫及官屬王璧、李琦、傅瑜極力守禦，城得不拔。

translations.literal: At the time secretary Ji Yuxi and officials Wang Bi, Li Qi, and Fu Yu defended with all their strength, and the city was not taken.
translations.idiomatic: Secretary Ji Yuxi and officials Wang Bi, Li Qi, and Fu Yu defended with all their strength, and the city held.

sentences.zh: 方大兵圍城，決鳳池大橋水以護城。

translations.literal: As the great army besieged the city, they planned to breach the Phoenix Pool great bridge to release water to protect the city.
translations.idiomatic: As the Mongol army besieged the city, they planned to breach the Phoenix Pool bridge and release water to protect the city.

sentences.zh: 都水官言，去歲河決敖游堌時，會以水準量之，其地與城中龍興塔平，果決此口，則無城矣。

translations.literal: The director of waterways said that when the river broke at Aoyougu last year, they had measured with a water level—the ground was level with the Longxing Pagoda in the city; if this breach were made, there would be no city left.
translations.idiomatic: The director of waterways said that when the river had broken at Aoyougu the previous year, measurements showed the ground was level with the Longxing Pagoda inside the city. If this breach were made, the city would be destroyed.

sentences.zh: 及大兵至，不得已遣招撫陳貴往決之，才出門，為遊騎所鈔，無一返者。

translations.literal: When the great army arrived, they had no choice but to send pacification commissioner Chen Gui to breach it; he had barely left the gate when roaming cavalry seized him—not one returned.
translations.idiomatic: When the Mongol army arrived, they had no choice but to send pacification commissioner Chen Gui to breach the dam. He had barely left the gate when scouting horsemen seized him. Not one man returned.

sentences.zh: 三月壬午朔，攻城不能下，大軍中有獻決河之策者，主將從之。

translations.literal: On the first day of the third month, renwu, the attack could not bring the city down; someone in the great army offered a plan to breach the river, and the commander followed it.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the third month, the attack still could not take the city. Someone in the Mongol army proposed breaching the river, and the commander agreed.

sentences.zh: 河既決，水從西北而下，至城西南，入故濉水道，城反以水為固。

translations.literal: Once the river was breached, water flowed down from the northwest to the city's southwest and entered the old Sui River channel; the city was instead secured by water.
translations.idiomatic: Once the river was breached, water flowed from the northwest to the city's southwest and entered the old Sui River channel. The city was instead secured by the flood.

sentences.zh: 求獻策者欲殺之，而不知所在。

translations.literal: They sought the man who offered the plan to kill him, but did not know where he was.
translations.idiomatic: They sought the man who had proposed the plan in order to kill him, but could not find him.

sentences.zh: 四月，以女魯歡為總帥，佩金虎符。

translations.literal: In the fourth month Nülühuan was made overall commander and wore the golden tiger tally.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month Nülühuan was appointed overall commander and given the golden tiger tally.

sentences.zh: 罷司農司，以其官蒲察世達為集慶軍節度使、行六部侍郎。

translations.literal: The Directorate of Agriculture was abolished; its official Pucha Shida was made military commissioner of the Jiqing Army and acting vice minister of the Six Departments.
translations.idiomatic: The Directorate of Agriculture was abolished. Its official Pucha Shida was appointed military commissioner of the Jiqing Army and acting vice minister of the Six Departments.

sentences.zh: 溫特罕道僧歸德府同知，李無黨府判。

translations.literal: Wentehan Daoseng was made Guide Prefecture vice prefect; Li Wudang was made prefectural judge.
translations.idiomatic: Wentehan Daoseng was appointed Guide Prefecture vice prefect, and Li Wudang was appointed prefectural judge.

sentences.zh: 五月，圍城稍緩，頗遷民出城就食。

translations.literal: In the fifth month the siege eased somewhat, and many civilians were moved out of the city to obtain food.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month the siege eased somewhat, and many civilians were sent out of the city to obtain food.

sentences.zh: 十二月，哀宗次黃陵岡，遣奉職術甲搭失不、奉職權奉禦粘合斜烈來歸德征糧。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month Emperor Aizong halted at Huangling Hill and sent duty officer Shujia Dashibu and acting imperial attendant Nihe Xielie to Guide to levy grain.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Emperor Aizong halted at Huangling Hill and sent duty officer Shujia Dashibu and acting imperial attendant Nihe Xielie to Guide to levy grain.

sentences.zh: 女魯歡遣侍郎世達，治中王元慶權郎中，儀封從宜完顏胡土權元帥，護送載糧千五百石。

translations.literal: Nülühuan sent vice minister Shida, administrative supervisor Wang Yuanqing as acting bureau director, and Yifeng attendant Wanyan Hutu as acting commander to escort fifteen hundred shi of grain.
translations.idiomatic: Nülühuan sent vice minister Shida, administrative supervisor Wang Yuanqing as acting bureau director, and Yifeng attendant Wanyan Hutu as acting commander to escort fifteen hundred shi of grain.

sentences.zh: 是月晦二更發船。

translations.literal: At the second watch on the last day of the month the boats set out.
translations.idiomatic: At the second watch on the last day of the month the boats set out.

sentences.zh: 二年正月，達蒲城東二十裏。

translations.literal: In the first month of the second year they reached twenty li east of Pucheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the following year they reached a point twenty li east of Pucheng.

sentences.zh: 六軍給糧盡，因留船不聽歸，且命張布為幄，上遂用此舟以濟。

translations.literal: The Six Armies' grain allotment was exhausted; they therefore kept the boats and would not allow them to return, and moreover ordered Zhang Bu to make an awning; the emperor then used this boat to cross.
translations.idiomatic: The Six Armies' grain allotment was exhausted. They kept the boats and refused to let them return, ordered Zhang Bu to rig an awning, and the emperor used this vessel to cross the river.

sentences.zh: 及上來歸德，隨駕軍往往出城就糧，時城中止有馬用一軍，近七百人。

translations.literal: When the emperor came to Guide, the troops accompanying the imperial progress often went out of the city to obtain grain; at the time only Ma Yong's single army remained in the city, nearly seven hundred men.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor came to Guide, the troops accompanying him often left the city to obtain grain. Only Ma Yong's force remained in the city, nearly seven hundred men.

sentences.zh: 用山西人，與李辛同鄉裏，嘗為辛軍彈壓，在歸德權果毅都尉，車駕至，授以帥職。

translations.literal: Yong was a Shanxi man, from the same district as Li Xin; he had once suppressed Xin's army; in Guide he was acting guoyi commandant; when the imperial carriage arrived he was granted command.
translations.idiomatic: Yong was a Shanxi man from the same district as Li Xin and had once been sent to suppress Xin's army. In Guide he served as acting guoyi commandant, and when the imperial carriage arrived he was granted command authority.

sentences.zh: 此軍外複有官奴忠孝軍四百五十人。

translations.literal: Besides this army there were also Guannu's Loyalty-and-Filiality Army of four hundred fifty men.
translations.idiomatic: Besides this force there were also Guannu's Loyalty-and-Filiality Army of four hundred fifty men.

sentences.zh: 河北潰軍至者皆縱遣之，故城中惟此兩軍。

translations.literal: Routed troops arriving from Hebei were all released and sent away; therefore in the city there were only these two armies.
translations.idiomatic: Routed troops arriving from Hebei were all dismissed, so only these two forces remained in the city.

sentences.zh: 上時召用計事，而不及官奴，故官奴有異心。

translations.literal: The emperor would summon Yong to discuss plans but did not include Guannu; therefore Guannu harbored disloyal thoughts.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor summoned Yong to discuss strategy but excluded Guannu, who therefore began to harbor disloyal thoughts.

sentences.zh: 朝廷知兩人不協，恐生變。

translations.literal: The court knew the two men were not in harmony and feared trouble would arise.
translations.idiomatic: The court knew the two men were at odds and feared an outbreak of trouble.

sentences.zh: 三月戊辰，制旨令宰相錫宴省中，和解之。

translations.literal: On the wuchen day of the third month an imperial order directed the chief ministers to host a banquet in the Secretariat to reconcile them.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day of the third month an imperial order directed the chief ministers to host a reconciliation banquet in the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 是夜，用撤備，官奴以兵乘之為亂。

translations.literal: That night Yong relaxed his guard; Guannu took advantage with troops and made a disturbance.
translations.idiomatic: That night Yong relaxed his guard. Guannu seized the opportunity and raised troops in revolt.

sentences.zh: 明日，攻用軍，用敗走被殺，眾下城投水奪船而去者，斯須而盡。

translations.literal: The next day he attacked Yong's army; Yong was defeated, fled, and was killed. The masses below the city threw themselves into the water to seize boats and flee—all within a moment.
translations.idiomatic: The next day he attacked Yong's army. Yong was defeated, fled, and was killed. His men below the city walls threw themselves into the water to seize boats and escape, and within moments they were gone.

sentences.zh: 官奴在雙門，驅知府女魯歡至，言「汝自車駕到府，上供不給，好醬亦不與，汝罪何辭。」

translations.literal: Guannu was at the Double Gate; he drove prefect Nülühuan forward and said, "Since the imperial carriage arrived at the prefecture, you have not supplied the court, nor even given fine sauce—what excuse have you for your crime?"
translations.idiomatic: Guannu was at the Double Gate. He drove Prefect Nülühuan forward and said, "Since the imperial carriage arrived, you have failed to supply the court—even fine sauce you would not provide. What excuse do you have?"

sentences.zh: 遂以一馬載之。

translations.literal: He then had him carried on a single horse.
translations.idiomatic: He then had him placed on a horse.

sentences.zh: 令軍士擁至其家，檢其家雜醬凡二十甕，且出所有金具，然後殺之。

translations.literal: He ordered soldiers to escort him to his home, searched his household and found miscellaneous sauces totaling twenty jars, and moreover produced all his gold vessels—then killed him.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered soldiers to escort Nülühuan to his home, searched the house, and found twenty jars of assorted sauces along with all his gold vessels. Only then was he killed.

sentences.zh: 即提兵入見，言「石盞女魯歡等反，臣殺之矣。」

translations.literal: He then led troops in to see the emperor and said, "Shizhan Nülühuan and others rebelled; your servant has killed them."
translations.idiomatic: He then led his troops in to see the emperor and reported, "Shizhan Nülühuan and others rebelled. I have killed them."

sentences.zh: 上不得已，就赦其罪，且暴女魯歡之惡。

translations.literal: The emperor had no choice but to pardon his crime on the spot, and moreover exposed Nülühuan's wickedness.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor had no choice but to pardon him on the spot and publicly denounced Nülühuan's crimes.

sentences.zh: 後其侄大安入蔡，上言求湔雪，上複其官，語在烏古論鎬傳。

translations.literal: Later his nephew Da'an entered Cai and memorialized requesting vindication; the emperor restored his office—the account is in the biography of Wugulun Gao.
translations.idiomatic: Later his nephew Da'an entered Cai and petitioned for vindication. The emperor restored Nülühuan's office. The account appears in the biography of Wugulun Gao.

sentences.zh: 禾速嘉兀底代女魯歡為總帥，軍變，官奴無意害兀底，使二卒召之，道官奴有善意。

translations.literal: Hesujia Wudi replaced Nülühuan as overall commander. During the army disturbance Guannu had no intention of harming Wudi and sent two soldiers to summon him, saying Guannu had good intentions.
translations.idiomatic: Hesujia Wudi replaced Nülühuan as overall commander. During the army disturbance Guannu had no wish to harm Wudi and sent two soldiers to summon him, saying Guannu meant him no harm.

sentences.zh: 兀底喜，各以金十星與之，同見官奴。

translations.literal: Wudi was pleased and each gave them ten stars of gold; they went together to see Guannu.
translations.idiomatic: Wudi was pleased and each gave the soldiers ten stars of gold. They went together to see Guannu.

sentences.zh: 二卒複恐受金事泄，亦殺之。

translations.literal: The two soldiers again feared the matter of receiving gold would leak out, and killed him as well.
translations.idiomatic: The two soldiers then feared that accepting the gold would be exposed, and they killed Wudi as well.

sentences.zh: 初，河北潰軍至歸德，糧餉不給。

translations.literal: At the outset, when routed troops from Hebei reached Guide, provisions were not supplied.
translations.idiomatic: When routed troops from Hebei first reached Guide, provisions were not supplied.

sentences.zh: 朝庭命孛術魯阿海行總帥府事，以親軍武衛皆隸之。

translations.literal: The court ordered Xuezhulu Ahai to exercise metropolitan command affairs, with the imperial guard Wuwei all placed under him.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered Xuezhulu Ahai to exercise metropolitan command authority, with the imperial guard Wuwei placed under his command.

sentences.zh: 往宿州就食，軍士有不願者，誶語道中，朝廷聞之，使問其故。

translations.literal: They were sent to Suzhou to obtain food; some soldiers were unwilling and cursed along the road; the court heard of it and sent to ask the reason.
translations.idiomatic: They were sent to Suzhou to obtain food. Some soldiers were unwilling and cursed along the road. The court heard of it and sent to inquire why.

sentences.zh: 或言願入京或陳州，阿海請從其願，以券給之，軍心稍定。

translations.literal: Some said they wished to enter the capital or Chen Prefecture; Ahai requested to follow their wishes and gave them passes; army morale was somewhat settled.
translations.idiomatic: Some said they wished to go to the capital or Chen Prefecture. Ahai asked permission to grant their wishes and issued them passes. Army morale settled somewhat.

sentences.zh: 既而令求誶語者，阿海得四人，斬之國子監前，由是諸軍洶洶。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward they ordered those who cursed to be sought; Ahai obtained four men and beheaded them before the Directorate of Education; by this the various armies were in uproar.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly afterward the court ordered those who had cursed to be found. Ahai seized four men and beheaded them before the Directorate of Education, throwing the armies into uproar.

sentences.zh: 二月庚子夜，劫府民武邦傑及蒲察咬住等凡九家，一軍遂散。

translations.literal: On the gengzi night of the second month they robbed nine households including prefectural resident Wu Bangjie and Pucha Yaozhu; one army then scattered.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi night of the second month they robbed nine households including prefectural resident Wu Bangjie and Pucha Yaozhu. One entire army then scattered.

sentences.zh: 數日，遂有官奴之變。

translations.literal: Within several days Guannu's mutiny followed.
translations.idiomatic: Within days Guannu's mutiny followed.

sentences.zh: 蒲察官奴

translations.literal: Pucha Guannu
translations.idiomatic: Pucha Guannu

sentences.zh: 蒲察官奴，少嘗為北兵所虜，往來河朔。

translations.literal: Pucha Guannu in his youth was once captured by northern troops and traveled back and forth in Heshuo.
translations.idiomatic: Pucha Guannu was once captured by northern troops in his youth and traveled back and forth across Heshuo.

sentences.zh: 後以奸事系燕城獄，劫走夏津，殺回紇使者得鞍馬資貨，即自拔歸。

translations.literal: Later for a wicked affair he was imprisoned in Yancheng; he broke out at Xiajin, killed a Uyghur envoy and obtained saddles, horses, and goods, then escaped back on his own.
translations.idiomatic: Later he was imprisoned in Yancheng for a criminal affair, broke out at Xiajin, killed a Uyghur envoy, seized saddles, horses, and goods, and made his own way back.

sentences.zh: 朝廷以其種人，特恩收充忠孝軍萬戶。

translations.literal: The court, because he was of their ethnic group, specially favored him and enrolled him as commander of ten thousand of the Loyalty-and-Filiality Army.
translations.idiomatic: Because he was of their ethnic group, the court specially favored him and enrolled him as commander of ten thousand of the Loyalty-and-Filiality Army.

sentences.zh: 此軍月給甚憂，官奴日與群不逞博，為有司所劾。

translations.literal: This army's monthly allotment was very meager; Guannu daily gambled with a band of ruffians and was impeached by the authorities.
translations.idiomatic: This army's monthly pay was very meager. Guannu gambled daily with a band of ruffians and was impeached by the authorities.

sentences.zh: 事聞，以其新自河朔來，未知法禁，詔勿問。

translations.literal: When the matter was reported, because he had newly come from Heshuo and did not know legal prohibitions, an edict ordered that he not be prosecuted.
translations.idiomatic: When the matter was reported, an edict ordered that he not be prosecuted, on the grounds that he had newly come from Heshuo and did not yet know the laws.

sentences.zh: 移剌蒲阿攻平陽，官奴請行，論功第一，遷本軍提控，佩金符。

translations.literal: Yila Pu'a attacked Pingyang; Guannu requested to go, and for merit ranked first; he was promoted to commander of his army and wore the golden tally.
translations.idiomatic: When Yila Pu'a attacked Pingyang, Guannu volunteered to go and ranked first in merit. He was promoted to commander of his army and given the golden tally.

sentences.zh: 三峰山之敗，走襄陽，說宋制使以取鄧州自效，制使信之，至與同燕飲。

translations.literal: After the defeat at Sanfeng Mountain he fled to Xiangyang and persuaded the Song commissioner to let him take Dengzhou to prove his worth; the commissioner trusted him, even drinking with him at the same banquet.
translations.idiomatic: After the defeat at Sanfeng Mountain he fled to Xiangyang and persuaded the Song commissioner to let him capture Dengzhou to prove his loyalty. The commissioner trusted him and even drank with him at the same banquet.

sentences.zh: 已而知汴城罷攻，複謀北歸。

translations.literal: When he learned the siege of Bian had been lifted, he again plotted to return north.
translations.idiomatic: When he learned the siege of Bian had been lifted, he plotted again to return north.

sentences.zh: 遣移剌留哥入鄧，說鄧帥粘合，稱欲劫南軍為北歸計。

translations.literal: He sent Yila Liuge into Deng to persuade Deng commander Nihe, claiming he wished to seize the southern army as a plan for returning north.
translations.idiomatic: He sent Yila Liuge into Deng to persuade Deng commander Nihe, claiming he planned to seize the southern army to facilitate his return north.

sentences.zh: 留哥以情告粘合，官奴繼以騎卒十餘入城議事，粘合欲就甕城中擒之。

translations.literal: Liuge told Nihe the truth; Guannu followed with more than ten horsemen to enter the city and discuss affairs; Nihe wished to capture him in the jar-city.
translations.idiomatic: Liuge told Nihe the truth. Guannu followed with more than ten horsemen to enter the city for talks. Nihe planned to capture him in the jar-city fortification.

sentences.zh: 官奴知事泄，即馳還，見制得騎兵五百，掠鄧之邊面小城，獲牛羊數百，宋人不疑。

translations.literal: Guannu knew the affair was exposed and galloped back; he saw the commissioner and obtained five hundred horsemen, raided small towns on Deng's border, obtained several hundred cattle and sheep, and the Song did not suspect.
translations.idiomatic: Guannu learned the plot was exposed and galloped back. He obtained five hundred horsemen from the commissioner, raided small towns on Deng's border, seized several hundred cattle and sheep, and the Song suspected nothing.

sentences.zh: 官奴掩宋軍得馬三百，至鄧州城下，移書粘合辨理屈直，留馬于鄧而去。

translations.literal: Guannu ambushed Song troops and obtained three hundred horses; he reached below Dengzhou city, sent a letter to Nihe arguing right and wrong, left the horses at Deng, and departed.
translations.idiomatic: Guannu ambushed Song troops and seized three hundred horses. He reached Dengzhou, sent Nihe a letter arguing his case, left the horses at Deng, and departed.

sentences.zh: 乃縛忠孝軍提控姬旺，詐為唐州太守，械送北行，隨營帳取供給，因得入汴。

translations.literal: He then bound Loyalty-and-Filiality Army commander Ji Wang, falsely presenting him as Tang Prefecture prefect, sent him north in fetters, followed the camp to obtain supplies, and thereby entered Bian.
translations.idiomatic: He bound Loyalty-and-Filiality Army commander Ji Wang, falsely presented him as prefect of Tangzhou, and sent him north in fetters. Following the camp for supplies, Guannu thereby entered Bian.

sentences.zh: 有言其出入南北軍，行數千里而不懾，其智略有可取者，宰相以為然，乃使權副都尉。

translations.literal: Some said that moving between northern and southern armies, traveling several thousand li without fear, his resourcefulness had something to recommend; the chief minister thought so and made him acting deputy commandant.
translations.idiomatic: Some said that his ability to move between northern and southern armies and travel thousands of li without fear showed resourcefulness worth employing. The chief minister agreed and appointed him acting deputy commandant.

sentences.zh: 未幾，提軍數百馳入北軍獵騎中，生挾一回紇而還。

translations.literal: Before long, leading several hundred troops he galloped into the northern army's hunting horsemen and seized a Uyghur alive and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he led several hundred men into the Mongol hunting parties, seized a Uyghur alive, and returned.

sentences.zh: 遂巡黃陵、八穀等處，劫牛羊糧資甚眾，尋轉正都尉。

translations.literal: He then ranged through Huangling, Bagu, and other places, seizing very many cattle, sheep, grain, and goods; shortly he was made full commandant.
translations.idiomatic: He then ranged through Huangling, Bagu, and other places, seizing large numbers of cattle, sheep, grain, and goods. He was soon promoted to full commandant.

sentences.zh: 又以軍至黃陵，幾獲鎮州大將，於是中外皆以為可用，遂拜為元帥，統馬軍。

translations.literal: Again leading troops to Huangling he nearly captured the Zhenzhou great general; thereupon within and without all considered him usable, and he was appointed commander, commanding the horse army.
translations.idiomatic: Leading troops to Huangling again, he nearly captured the Zhenzhou commander. Thereafter court and camp alike considered him employable, and he was appointed commander with authority over the cavalry.

sentences.zh: 是時，惟官奴忠孝軍四百五十人、馬用軍七百人留府中。

translations.literal: At this time only Guannu's Loyalty-and-Filiality Army of four hundred fifty men and Ma Yong's army of seven hundred remained in the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: At this time only Guannu's Loyalty-and-Filiality Army of four hundred fifty men and Ma Yong's force of seven hundred remained in the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 用本果毅都尉，上至歸德始升為元帥，又嘗召之謀事，而不及官奴，故官奴始有圖用之志。

translations.literal: Yong had originally been guoyi commandant; when the emperor reached Guide he was only then promoted to commander; moreover the emperor had summoned him to discuss affairs but not Guannu—therefore Guannu first formed the intent to destroy Yong.
translations.idiomatic: Yong had originally been a guoyi commandant and was promoted to commander only when the emperor reached Guide. The emperor summoned him to discuss strategy but excluded Guannu, who therefore first formed the intent to destroy Yong.

sentences.zh: 是時，大元將忒木泬攻歸德。

translations.literal: At this time the Great Yuan general Temü attacked Guide.
translations.idiomatic: At this time the Mongol general Temü attacked Guide.

sentences.zh: 官奴既總兵柄，私與國用安謀，欲邀上幸海州。

translations.literal: Guannu having taken overall military authority, privately plotted with Guo Yong'an, wishing to invite the emperor to favor Haizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Once Guannu held overall military authority, he plotted privately with Guo Yong'an to persuade the emperor to go to Haizhou.

sentences.zh: 及近侍局直長阿勒根兀惹使用安回，附奏帖，謂海州可就山東豪傑以圖恢復，且已具舟楫，可通遼東。

translations.literal: When Inner Service Bureau director Aleigen Wure used Yong'an to return, he attached a memorial note saying Haizhou could rely on Shandong heroes to plan restoration, and moreover boats were already prepared that could reach Liaodong.
translations.idiomatic: Inner Service Bureau director Aleigen Wure had Yong'an return with a memorial note claiming that at Haizhou they could rally Shandong heroes to plan restoration, that boats were already prepared, and that Liaodong could be reached.

sentences.zh: 上覽奏不從。

translations.literal: The emperor read the memorial and did not follow it.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor read the memorial and rejected it.

sentences.zh: 又嘗請上北渡，再圖恢復，女魯歡沮之，自是有異心矣。

translations.literal: He also once requested that the emperor cross north and again plan restoration; Nülühuan obstructed it—from this he had disloyal thoughts.
translations.idiomatic: He also once asked the emperor to cross north and plan restoration again. Nülühuan blocked the proposal, and from this Guannu harbored disloyal thoughts.

sentences.zh: 且一軍倚外兵肆為剽掠，官奴不之禁。

translations.literal: Moreover one army, relying on outside troops, indulged in plundering at will; Guannu did not prohibit it.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover one army, relying on outside support, plundered at will, and Guannu did not stop them.

sentences.zh: 於是，左丞李蹊、左右司郎中張天綱、近侍局副使李大節俱為上言官奴有反狀。

translations.literal: Thereupon left vice minister Li Xi, left and right department director Zhang Tiangang, and Inner Service Bureau deputy Li Dajie all told the emperor Guannu showed signs of rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon left vice minister Li Xi, left and right department director Zhang Tiangang, and Inner Service Bureau deputy Li Dajie all told the emperor that Guannu showed signs of rebellion.

sentences.zh: 上竊憂之，以馬軍總領紇石烈阿裏合、內族習顯陰察其動靜，與朝臣言及，則曰：「我從官奴微賤中起為大帥，何負而反耶？

translations.literal: The emperor secretly worried and had cavalry chief Geshilie Alihe and imperial clansman Xi Xian secretly observe his movements. When he spoke of it with court ministers he said: "I raised Guannu from low estate to great commander—what ingratitude could make him rebel?
translations.idiomatic: The emperor worried in secret and had cavalry chief Geshilie Alihe and imperial clansman Xi Xian observe Guannu covertly. When court ministers raised the matter, he said, "I raised Guannu from humble origins to great commander. What ingratitude could make him rebel?

sentences.zh: 卿等勿過慮。」

translations.literal: You all need not worry excessively."
translations.idiomatic: You need not worry excessively."

sentences.zh: 阿裏合、習顯知官奴漸不能制，反泄上意。

translations.literal: Alihe and Xi Xian knew Guannu could gradually not be controlled and instead leaked the emperor's intentions.
translations.idiomatic: Alihe and Xi Xian realized Guannu was slipping from control and instead leaked the emperor's intentions to him.

sentences.zh: 上亦懼官奴、馬用相圖，因以為亂，命宰執置酒和解之。

translations.literal: The emperor also feared Guannu and Ma Yong would plot against each other and thereby make trouble; he ordered the chief ministers to set out wine to reconcile them.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor also feared that Guannu and Ma Yong would plot against each other and cause an outbreak of trouble. He ordered the chief ministers to host a reconciliation banquet.

sentences.zh: 用撤備。

translations.literal: Yong relaxed his guard.
translations.idiomatic: Yong relaxed his guard.

sentences.zh: 俄官奴乘隙率其軍攻用，用軍敗走。

translations.literal: Shortly Guannu seized the opportunity and led his army to attack Yong; Yong's army was defeated and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly afterward Guannu seized the opportunity and led his army against Yong. Yong's force was defeated and fled.

sentences.zh: 官奴亂殺軍民，以卒五十人守行宮。

translations.literal: Guannu wantonly killed soldiers and civilians and posted fifty soldiers to guard the traveling palace.
translations.idiomatic: Guannu slaughtered soldiers and civilians indiscriminately and posted fifty soldiers to guard the traveling palace.

sentences.zh: 劫朝官皆聚于都水毛花輦宅，以兵監焉。

translations.literal: The seized court officials were all gathered at the Directorate of Waterways Mao Huanian's residence and guarded by troops.
translations.idiomatic: The seized court officials were gathered at Directorate of Waterways Mao Huanian's residence and placed under military guard.

sentences.zh: 驅參知政事石盞女魯歡至其家，悉出所有金具，然後殺之。

translations.literal: He drove councilor Shizhan Nülühuan to his home, produced all his gold vessels, and then killed him.
translations.idiomatic: He drove Councilor Shizhan Nülühuan to his home, seized all his gold vessels, and then killed him.

sentences.zh: 乃遣都尉馬實被甲持刃劫直長把奴申於上前，上初握劍，見實，擲劍於地曰：「為我言于元帥，我左右止有此人，且留侍我。」

translations.literal: He then sent commandant Ma Shi in armor with blade to seize director Banushen before the emperor; the emperor at first grasped his sword, saw Shi, and cast the sword to the ground, saying: "Speak to the commander for me—I have only this man at my side; let him remain to attend me."
translations.idiomatic: He sent commandant Ma Shi in armor with drawn blade to seize director Banushen before the emperor. The emperor at first grasped his sword, but seeing Shi he cast it to the ground and said, "Tell the commander for me that I have only this man at my side. Let him remain to attend me."

sentences.zh: 實不敢迫，逡巡而退。

translations.literal: Shi did not dare press him and withdrew hesitantly.
translations.idiomatic: Shi did not dare press the matter and withdrew hesitantly.

sentences.zh: 凡殺朝官左丞李蹊已下三百餘人，軍將、禁衛、民庶死者三千。

translations.literal: In all more than three hundred court officials from left vice minister Li Xi downward were killed; three thousand military officers, imperial guards, and common people died.
translations.idiomatic: In all more than three hundred court officials from left vice minister Li Xi downward were killed, along with three thousand military officers, imperial guards, and civilians.

sentences.zh: 郎中完顏胡魯剌、都事冀禹錫赴水死。

translations.literal: Bureau director Wanyan Hulula and secretary Ji Yuxi went into the water and died.
translations.idiomatic: Bureau director Wanyan Hulula and secretary Ji Yuxi drowned themselves.

sentences.zh: 禹錫字京甫，龍山人。

translations.literal: Yuxi's style name was Jingfu; he was a native of Longshan.
translations.idiomatic: Yuxi, style name Jingfu, was a native of Longshan.

sentences.zh: 至甯元年進士，仕曆州郡有能聲。
